summary.text: Adrian Plank is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 47, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Plank is a carpenter who owns and operates a small business.

paragraphs.text: Adrian Plank was born in Huntsville, Missouri, and lives in Boone County.
He graduated from Westran High School and attended Central Missouri State University.
His career experience includes working as a carpenter and owning and operating a small business, and he joined the Carpenters Union 1925.
In the Missouri House, Plank was assigned to the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee for 2025-2026.
His 2023-2024 assignments were the Agriculture Policy, Rural Community Development and Workforce Development committees.
